blind.description: A vertical stack of three tiered rectangular strongboxes decreasing in size towards the top. Each box is made of dark aged iron/steel with reinforced riveted corner bands, circular iron drop handles on the sides, and a hasp with a padlock on the front (the top padlock is brass/bronze, while the lower two are dark iron). All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and sit directly and flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A dark rectangular top surface of the smallest strongbox, bordered by riveted corner straps, with the wider edges, corners, and side handles of the two larger boxes stepping outward beneath it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (reaching roughly lower-hip height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide at the base chest.
